messages:
alia: Heads-up — around 00:40 we pushed an audit-filter tweak to the eu-west KMS policy. Now seeing GPU nodes fail to complete bootstrap because they can't decrypt node secrets. Provisioning stalled. Anyone oncall?

mike: which policy change exactly? link?

alia: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/commit/34b9a2 — added condition to deny decrypts for callers without audit-header. We thought it's safe.

sara: seeing repeated errors from the keystore-proxy: 
```
ERROR keystore-proxy: decrypt request failed: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:...
 at keystore.Service.handleDecrypt
```

kevin: oh. the condition breaks instance role flows that come via the warm-pool path (no audit header). that explains bootstrap.

ci-bot: [ALERT] autoscaler: 38 nodes in eu-west warmpool pending due to keystore decrypt failures; scaling paused.

mike: can we add a temporary exception for the node role? e.g. grant kms:Decrypt for role arn:... with a tag condition instead of audit-header.

alia: tried a one-off grant via console — nodes still fail because the decrypt happens from within the ASG lifecycle hook using the instance-profile STS creds. policy eval seems to be rejecting due to missing header at the proxy layer.

kevin: quick workaround: relax the audit-header condition for the keystore proxy path only (not global). we can patch nginx to inject header for node bootstrap path. small change.

sara: nginx patch sounds safer than broad KMS relax. but that needs infra deploy which is slower. can we flip the proxy to accept headerless decrypts for requests from the VPC subnet range?

mike: if we do subnet allowlist, security will scream. tagging would be better.

security: linking in — any permanent change to KMS conditions needs a compliance exception documented. if it's emergency, get approval post-fix.

alia: timeline: nodes stuck ~25min, customer-facing pools unaffected so far, but queue is building. cost impact if we start repinning to other regions.

kevin: i'm pushing a small nginx config to staging that injects X-Audit-Header for requests coming from instance lifecycle hook UA. snippet: 
```
proxy_set_header X-Audit-Header "node-bootstrap";
```

ci-bot: [INFO] deploy pipeline queued: infra/nginx:patch-312 -> staging.

mike: alt plan: manually rotate pods in eu-west keystore-proxy to an image that skips the header requirement (feature-flag off). Faster?

sara: we can do that; but don't forget to toggle audit logging down — KMS QPS is high when we retry decrypts. suggests we might hit quota.

kevin: i'm also preparing a minimal IAM grant for the node role: `kms:Decrypt` scoped to the exact alias ARN and decorated with a short expiry policy. will open PR.

alia: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/489 — includes both nginx header injection and a short-lived role grant if header path fails.

ops-bot: Incident I-2026-052 created: "eu-west: KMS audit condition blocks warmpool bootstrap" — runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/i-2026-052

mike: who can approve emergency minimal grant? @security

security: i'm marking this P0 for compliance review. Approved provisional grant for 2 hours. Please add full justification in the incident doc.

alia: applying nginx patch now to keystore-proxy canary, will monitor.

ci-bot: canary deploy succeeded. keystore-proxy-canary-2 logs: `INFO decrypt success for instance i-0a1b2c3d`.

alia: warmpool nodes are starting to join again — 12/38 processed.

mike: great. keep an eye on KMS usage — if we hit throttle we'll need to throttle node join rate.

sara: joining rate limited by autoscaler; we can bump join window to spread QPS. but that increases time to capacity and cost.

kevin: nginx patch merged, short-lived role grant applied (2h). I'm recording the grant id in the incident.

alia: confirming eu-west warmpool back to nominal in ~15 minutes. thank you all.

security: reminder: we'll need a postmortem that covers why the audit-header condition was rolled without a canary for instance bootstrap paths, plus action items for safer policy rollout (feature-flagged condition, infra tests).

mike: agree. cost note: we used a small cross-region temporary fallback (us-west warmpool) for 6 nodes — eyeballing an extra $1.2k for the hour. add to incident cost bucket.

sara: I'll start the postmortem draft and include logs + policy diff + proposed change to deploy-checklist.

alia: leaving follow-up tasks in the incident: revert temporary grant, add bootstrap unit test, add e2e canary for audit header condition, update runbook.

ops-bot: Incident I-2026-052 status -> mitigated. next: postmortem required (72h SLA).

kevin: noted. sending final commit to infra: `revert-temporary-grant` once audit header change validated.

mike: thanks team — good coordination. :thumbsup:

sara: filing the postmortem now.

alia: closing chat — will update incident doc with final timestamps and cost line items.
